title: Downloading documents from the site binder

sections.heading: Download button is greyed out
sections.text: The Download button is available only for documents in Final status. Documents still in Draft or In Review status can be previewed but not downloaded.

steps.text: Ask the user to check the Status column for the document in the site binder.
Share this article section explaining that only Final documents can be downloaded.

information_needed.prompt: The document name as shown in the site binder.

stop_conditions.text: If the user cannot download a Final document their role should allow, stop and escalate as a possible permission configuration issue.

sections.heading: Downloaded PDF will not open
sections.text: Downloaded documents are PDF files. If the file does not open, the device may lack a PDF viewer or the download may be incomplete.

steps.text: Ask the user to confirm a PDF viewer is installed and set as the default for PDF files.
Ask the user to download the document again and open it from the downloads folder.

information_needed.prompt: The exact error message shown, copied without any subject or patient details.
